rules.entry: Close on the first trading day after the lean date (no same-day peeking).
rules.exit: Close on the first trading day at least N calendar days after entry.
rules.hit: Tailwind = right if the stock rose; headwind = right if it fell. 'Vs market' compares the stock's move with SPY over the same days.
rules.noCall: Mixed and quiet leans aren't calls, so they aren't scored.
rules.liveSampling: Live leans are logged daily; we score the first snapshot of each week per stock so one call isn't counted seven times.

backtest.note: Reconstructed leans, not live calls. Each checkpoint uses only data points that would have been public by that date (conservative publication lags; SEC numbers by first filing date). Values are today's vintage, so later revisions to government data are included.
